title: Citation
description: One occurrence of an explicit legal reference in a document: a rule-derived textual reference, kept outside the document. Explicit = a provision designator (§ / Art.) followed by a known act, an EU act number or 'leg. cit.' (the act cited last before it in the paragraph), a law-gazette or EU act number, or a formal decision identifier (case number, ECLI, VfSlg number, CJEU case number, ECtHR application number). A law-gazette number ('BGBl. I Nr. 100/2005') is of type publication_reference: the issue of the federal law gazette in which an act or its amendment was published; kept with its span, but not a citation of a norm.

start.description: Offset into the citing document's full_text.

normalized.description: Normalized form of the cited item, e.g. 'AsylG 2005 § 3 Abs. 1', 'VwGH Ra 2021/18/0336', 'VfGH E 988/2025', 'EuGH C-608/22', 'BGBl. I Nr. 100/2005'.

target_id.description: The cited document where `normalized` names exactly one document of the citation index (null where that is the citing document itself): BVwG document numbers, ECLI and VwGH / VfGH case numbers, of the BVwG documents for a BVwG decision and of the documents of all three courts for a VwGH or VfGH decision. Otherwise, for an Austrian case number, the case_reference_id of the cited case. Null for legislation and other identifiers (VfSlg, CJEU and ECtHR numbers, law-gazette and EU act numbers).

case_reference_id.description: case:<court>:<case number as spelled in RIS>, e.g. case:vwgh:Ra 2018/01/0106, case:vfgh:E2858/2025, case:bvwg:W150 2159588-2.
